question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing right winger, Claire is playing fullback, Dave is playing center midfielder, and Eve is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Finally, Claire and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) right winger
(C) fullback
(D) center midfielder
(E) goalkeeper
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: cheerleader, right winger, fullback, center midfielder, goalkeeper
1. Bob ↔ Claire: cheerleader, fullback, right winger, center midfielder, goalkeeper
2. Dave ↔ Alice: center midfielder, fullback, right winger, cheerleader, goalkeeper
3. Alice ↔ Bob: fullback, center midfielder, right winger, cheerleader, goalkeeper
4. Claire ↔ Dave: fullback, center midfielder, cheerleader, right winger, goalkeeper
5. Claire ↔ Eve: fullback, center midfielder, goalkeeper, right winger, cheerleader
Dave is playing right winger, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
